note: THE DECLARED SHIPPED SET of the carry family, as DATA. A row is the carve's operation-plan pair (docs/internals/engine/rules.md#carve): the fold's dense rows a warp and the number of dense levels its operand is formed from, the readout's the same, the box's channel extent, and whether the publish is in registers (both sides' warps own the same leaves). The box's per-level extents, the depth and the widths are runtime addressing. [32, 1, 32, 1, 32, 0] is the alternating D = 2 box (4 lists x 32 rows a warp each side, publish through shared memory); [128, 2, 128, 2, 32, 1] the dense D = 2 box (one list x 128 rows a warp from two expanded levels, publish in registers). Rows are canonical-sorted and the generator refuses any other spelling, so an arm's INDEX is a property of the declaration.
